# Array transfer with independent contexts

An owned public static transfer retains the same Object-bounded method formal
in one array input and its array result. Independent String and Object[] contexts
keep their original values and fixed-arity varargs view. The short generic relay
allocates its original empty context array. Four frozen callers compare 96 cases
twice for source and SDK providers, checking aliases, array covariance and stores,
opaque/null results, late component casts, exact failures and staged writes.
Every recovered unit and original metadata entry is compiled and audited. Six
wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls test the observer and
binding boundary. Only owned in-memory code executes.
